description: List the replies your campaigns received, newest first. Bounces are left out. To watch for new replies, keep the first replyId of a call and pass it as after on the next one, instead of polling campaigns_get for its counts. Page back with nextBefore.

after.description: Only replies newer than this replyId

before.description: The nextBefore of the previous page

classification.description: Only replies of this kind; opportunity is a person answering with interest or a question

limit.description: Maximum replies to return on this page

since.description: Only replies received on or after this date or time, e.g. "2026-11-10" or "2026-11-10T09:00:00Z"

name: replies_list

contactId.description: The contact who replied, as contacts_list lists it

interested.description: On an opportunity: whether they want what was offered; null until judged and on other kinds

text.description: What they wrote, without the email they quoted

title: List the replies your campaigns received, newest first
